feedback.worked_solution:
We combine the sum and the constant multiple rules, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int (4f(x)+3g(x))\text{d}x & =\int (4\cdot \frac{1}{2}{e}^{x}+3(8x-\frac{2}{3}{x}^{3}))\text{d}x \\  & =\int (2{e}^{x}+24x-2{x}^{3})\text{d}x \\  & =2\int {e}^{x}\,\text{d}x+24\int x\,\text{d}x-2\int {x}^{3}\,\text{d}x \\  & =2{e}^{x}+24\cdot \frac{{x}^{2}}{2}-2\cdot \frac{{x}^{4}}{4}+C \\  & =2{e}^{x}-\frac{{x}^{4}}{2}+12{x}^{2}+C,\end{aligned}
$$

where $C$ is an arbitrary constant.
